events.headline: IRAN TO DECLARE NEW ‘RESTRICTED ZONE’ OUTSIDE STRAIT OF HORMUZ – OFFICIAL
events.detail: Iran will announce a “restricted zone” outside the Strait of Hormuz in the coming days, a top security official has said Read Full Article at RT.com

events.headline: US MISSILE STRIKE SINKS IRANIAN TANKER (VIDEO)
events.detail: An Iranian oil tanker has sunk in the Gulf of Oman after being attacked by American forces, US Central Command has said Read Full Article at RT.com
